payload.name: Preserve stated benefits of activities in extraction
payload.description: When a speaker explicitly states an activity or preference and also states its benefit, effect, or purpose, apply during extraction to preserve both in the extracted memory candidate.
content: If a message states an activity the speaker enjoys and explicitly states what that activity does for them (benefit, effect, purpose), include both the activity and the stated benefit/effect in the same profile or preference candidate.
Do not infer benefits the speaker did not state, and do not apply when the stated benefit is already present in the existing memory being updated.

solves: Extraction sometimes captures only an activity while dropping its stated benefit/effect, leaving memories unable to answer 'which activity helps X do Y'. Apply when a future message states an activity and explicitly describes its benefit, effect, or purpose; keep both in the extracted candidate. Do not apply when no benefit is stated or it is already in the memory being updated.
